thread:
marta: FYI I'm going to flip the feature flag `batching_new_kv` to staged (20%) at 10:30 PT today. I'll run the smoke checklist and monitor latencies for 30m. pinging infra on standby. :white_check_mark:
kevin: 👍 what's the safe default if we see error spikes? revert to `off` or `cached_small_batch`?
marta: revert to `off` for immediate rollback. I want `cached_small_batch` as followup config if we need a gentler step.
alex: can you post the exact flag command and the smoke queries you'll run? I'll add graph panels and synthetic checks.
marta: command: ```curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"flag":"batching_new_kv","state":"staged","percent":20}'```
Smoke checklist I'll run:
- verify tail latency on /v1/generate (p50/p95/p99)
- check error rate (5xx) and 429s by tenant
- confirm KV cache hit ratio stays stable
- run end-to-end small prompt flow for critical tenants
- ensure fallback to old path under 10ms extra latency
(Will paste results to the thread)
sophia: heads up — for Dedicated customers we should pin model variant to avoid mismatch. Marta can you add the rollout policy to the console so A/B traffic doesn't shift models?
marta: yep will pin variants for dedicated customers before flipping.
deploy-bot: scheduling toggle: user=marta window=10:30-10:40 PT, id=ff-1815-20pct, expected-duration=10m. Notifying oncall.
samir: I'll stand by for rollback and watch regional queues. If latencies > 150ms p95 for >5m in any region, we'll revert immediately.
kevin: Alex — can you make a short dashboard that's visible in ops channels (p95, error rate, cache hit) and add a slack alert threshold?
alex: on it — will post link in 10m.
marta: timeline recap: 10:30 flip to 20% staged, watch 30m, if no regressions increase or keep stable. Rollback plan = toggle off + sticky config to `cached_small_batch` if needed.
sophia: also add a log marker so we can filter traces by ff id `ff-1815-20pct`.
marta: done — added `ff_id` tag on requests.
samir: noted. I'll execute rollback if we hit the thresholds.
kevin: thanks all. I'll be reachable if anything pops. :thumbsup:
marta: thanks team — will post smoke results in ~15m after flip.
